This package contains the following policies:

## `network`

- ccnp-egress-blocking-graboid-crypto-miner-malware

Policy to Deny crypto-miners via ports

- cnp-deny-malware-tntbotinger-communication

Policy to deny tntbotinger communication over port 6697, 51982 and 1982

- cnp-egress-deny-panchan

Blocking ports of panchan malware

- cnp-ingress-deny-panchan

Blocking ports of panchan malware

- cnp-ingress-deny-syslogk

Blocking syslogk malware ingress ports
